project: Real-Data E2E Overnight Consolidated Loop (A -> B -> C)
overview: Consolidated large-scope PRD for unattended overnight execution that closes Loop A readiness, Loop B run/report contracts, and Loop C trust/citation/export contracts in one sequential dependency chain, with added recovery checkpoints, concurrency safety, and parity drift detection.
goals: Eliminate contradictory readiness, run, report, citation, and export states across UI and API surfaces.
Preserve strict fail-closed trust/export behavior while improving operator reliability.
Keep overnight execution deterministic, resumable, and observable.
nonGoals: Loop D and broader P1/P2 review/chat/resilience scope.
Production rollout for these workflows in this cycle.
Broad pack allowlist expansion beyond pack_09_bad_citation.
Dedicated telemetry dashboard buildout or separate copy-spec project in this phase.
successMetrics: A->B->C contract chain is stable under real-data packs with deterministic state transitions.
No unresolved planning questions remain for this consolidated overnight loop.
pack_09_bad_citation fail-closed behavior is operator-reachable and covered in PR/nightly smoke tiers.
Overnight runs can halt and resume without replaying completed stages.

uiNotes: Blocked readiness and blocked export states must include actionable next-step copy.
Error states are deterministic and never silent.
Invalid citations must not show stale highlight overlays.
Concurrent run-start attempts must render explicit duplicate or in-progress feedback.

importFormat.description: Fixture and operator execution is pack-driven via docs/08-example-data with allowlisted pack IDs and expected trust/fail-closed outcomes.

rules: Story order is mandatory and sequential: US-001 through US-012.
Readiness contract decisions land before run/report changes.
Run/report contract decisions land before trust/export changes.
Run polling cadence is fixed to 2s for queued/running states and stops at terminal states.
No compatibility shim for placeholder-row consumers is introduced.
pack_09_bad_citation smoke checks run in PR and nightly tiers.
On upstream contract failure, loop halts and writes checkpoint before any downstream story executes.

stories.title: Canonical readiness contract across list/detail/API
stories.description: As an operator, I want readiness states to match across list, detail, and run-start APIs so I can trust whether a matter is runnable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given pack_01_clean, readiness is runnable across list, detail, and API surfaces.
Given pack_02_missing_rea, readiness is blocked with explicit reason across list, detail, and API surfaces.
Example: run-start denial reason codes match blocked readiness reason text shown in UI.
Negative: UI never shows ready while run-start API denies missing prerequisites.

stories.title: Quick Start readiness gate is deterministic
stories.description: As an operator, I want Quick Start to start only when readiness is runnable so blocked contexts fail loudly.
acceptanceCriteria: Quick Start enablement is derived only from canonical readiness state.
Blocked readiness shows actionable reason and never enqueues a run.
Example: fixing missing prerequisites transitions blocked to runnable and enables Quick Start.
Negative: blocked start attempts cannot silently enqueue runs.

stories.title: Setup and readiness failure UX is explicit
stories.description: As an operator, I want setup failures surfaced clearly so recovery is obvious.
acceptanceCriteria: Upload/init/complete and readiness recomputation failures render deterministic errors with recovery actions.
Example: upload completion failure shows retry and does not mark readiness complete.
Negative: setup failures are never hidden behind indefinite loading states.

stories.title: Run lifecycle state machine is deterministic
stories.description: As an operator, I want run transitions to be stable so downstream behavior is trustworthy.
acceptanceCriteria: Runs follow allowed transitions only and terminal states are immutable.
Example: successful run transitions queued to running to completed with transition timestamps.
Negative: terminal runs never regress to non-terminal states.

stories.title: Report rows are sourced from real step outcomes
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want report rows to reflect real run outputs so triage is accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: Report rows are generated from persisted run step outputs for the selected run.
Example: pack_05_partial_release row statuses remain stable across reloads for the same run.
Negative: seeded fallback rows are not emitted for successful real-data runs.

stories.title: Run and report failure envelopes are explicit and safe
stories.description: As an operator, I want typed failure envelopes so recovery actions are clear and safe.
acceptanceCriteria: Run/report failures expose deterministic typed envelopes and recoverable UI states.
Example: failed active run shows typed error while preserving prior completed-run history.
Negative: failed runs must not show stale success rows.

stories.title: Citation outcomes are explicit success or typed failure
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want citation requests to return auditable outcomes so trust checks are deterministic.
acceptanceCriteria: Citation/render/pdf paths return valid payloads or typed failures.
Example: valid citation opens expected document page and trust metadata.
Negative: invalid citations never appear as ambiguous success or stale overlays.

stories.title: Export fail-closed behavior is strict and observable
stories.description: As an operator, I want blocked exports enforced deterministically so unsafe outputs cannot leak.
acceptanceCriteria: Export route enforces EXPORT_BLOCKED when trust or safety preconditions fail.
Example: pack_09_bad_citation produces blocked export with explicit reason and no download.
Negative: blocked or incomplete runs never produce signed download links.

stories.title: Demo-prod pack_09 allowlist and PR/nightly smoke
stories.description: As a demo operator, I want pack_09_bad_citation available in toolbar flow so fail-closed scenarios are operator-reachable.
acceptanceCriteria: Load-pack API and toolbar include pack_09_bad_citation.
PR and nightly smoke include pack_09 operator path checks.
Example: operator selects pack 09, runs flow, and observes blocked export contract.
Negative: non-allowlisted arbitrary pack IDs remain validation-rejected.

stories.title: Overnight loop recovery and checkpoint resume
stories.description: As an on-call operator, I want the overnight loop to stop safely and resume from checkpoint so failures do not corrupt downstream contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Loop persists checkpoint after each completed story with run context.
On contract-breaking failure, loop halts before downstream stories and writes structured failure checkpoint.
Example: failure at report stage halts before export stage and stores resume pointer.
Negative: loop never auto-continues into downstream stories after upstream failure.

stories.title: Run-start idempotency and concurrency guardrails
stories.description: As an operator, I want duplicate start actions to be safely de-duped so concurrent clicks or retries do not create conflicting runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Run-start endpoint enforces idempotency key or equivalent lock semantics per matter context.
Concurrent requests for same runnable context produce one canonical run and explicit duplicate response behavior.
Example: double-triggered Quick Start yields one run id and one informative duplicate response.
Negative: concurrent starts never create multiple active runs for the same context.

stories.title: Cross-surface parity drift detection and telemetry taxonomy
stories.description: As an engineering lead, I want parity checks and canonical telemetry tags so A->B->C drift is detected early.
acceptanceCriteria: Parity checks compare list/detail/run/report/export outputs for the same run context.
Telemetry tags use canonical fields stage, story_id, pack_id, and run_id across all loop surfaces.
Example: readiness parity mismatch fails verification and identifies exact stage and story.
Negative: smoke runs never pass when readiness_state_mismatch_detected is above zero.

keyImprovements: Added overnight recovery and checkpoint resume story US-010.
Added parity drift detection and telemetry taxonomy story US-012.

inScope: Loop A readiness and Quick Start gating closure.
Loop B run lifecycle and report contract closure.
Loop C citation, trust, export, and pack_09 operator allowlist closure.
Recovery and resumability for unattended overnight execution.
Concurrency safety and parity drift detection across surfaces.
functionalRequirements: FR-001: Canonical readiness reason model shared across list, detail, and run-start surfaces.
FR-002: Quick Start gating derives solely from canonical readiness state.
FR-003: Setup/readiness failures map to deterministic user-facing errors.
FR-004: Run-state transitions are canonical and enforced.
FR-005: Poll every 2s while run state is queued/running, stop at terminal.
FR-006: Report rows are run-scoped and sourced from persisted step outputs.
FR-007: Seeded fallback rows are removed from successful real-data paths.
FR-008: Run/report failure envelopes are typed and safe for UI use.
FR-009: Citation/render/pdf endpoints use success-or-typed-failure contracts.
FR-010: Export fail-closed gating remains strict via EXPORT_BLOCKED.
FR-011: pack_09_bad_citation is allowlisted in API and toolbar options.
FR-012: PR and nightly smoke tiers include pack_09 operator path coverage.
FR-013: Run/report row consistency invariants are enforced via schema constraints and monitoring.
FR-014: Report row generation is idempotent via deterministic step-output identity and conflict handling.
FR-015: Cross-surface state correctness checks keep list/detail/run/report/export aligned to one source of truth.
FR-016: Overnight loop persists checkpoints and fails closed before downstream execution on upstream failure.
FR-017: Run-start endpoint enforces idempotency and concurrency locking semantics.
FR-018: Telemetry taxonomy and parity assertion gates are mandatory in PR/nightly verification.

nextRouteHandlers: Keep handlers in app/**/route.ts with explicit supported HTTP methods.
Validate route params and body at the boundary before orchestration.
Keep heavy orchestration in shared server modules, not handler glue.
zod: Reuse shared schemas for readiness/run/citation/export contracts.
Use safeParse for user-facing validation and typed issues.
Use strict schema mode where unknown keys should fail.
tests: Prefer deterministic integration tests for contract logic.
Isolate fixtures and control clocks/randomness in assertions.
Run fast reliable checks in PR and heavier parity checks nightly.

performanceConsiderations: 2s polling cadence with bounded retry and timeout backoff.
Run-scoped bulk query patterns to avoid N+1 in report generation.
Safe caching of idempotent citation/render outcomes by pack/run.
Checkpoint persistence and bounded parallel expensive operations overnight.
failureStatesAndUX: Readiness blocked: explicit reason and next action.
Setup failures: deterministic banner with retry guidance.
Run/report failures: typed recoverable error states.
Invalid citations: citation_failed behavior and no stale evidence overlays.
Blocked exports: explicit blocked reason and triage handoff.
Invalid pack IDs: validation errors with no side effects.
Concurrent run-start attempts: explicit in-progress or duplicate feedback.
metricsLogging: report_rows_seeded_fallback_total target 0 on successful real-data runs.
export_blocked_total by run and failure category.
rollbackDisablePath: Use additive feature gates for readiness canonicalization and run-report real mapping.
On regression, fall back to blocked-default or fail-closed safe behavior.
Allowlist rollback by removing pack_09_bad_citation from API and UI enums.
Disable checkpoint-resume feature independently if needed.

risks: Hidden fallback branches may still produce inconsistent states.
Legacy consumer assumptions about placeholder semantics may cause transient mismatches.
Cross-surface copy or contract drift may reduce operator confidence.
Concurrency edges may bypass intended single-run behavior without strict locks.
dependencies: Existing apps/web folder, document, run, report, citation, and export APIs.
Sequential contract dependency chain readiness to run/report to trust/export.
Reliable fixture packs and smoke tooling for parity checks.

verificationPlan: Run quality gates: pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test.
Execute stories in strict dependency order US-001 through US-012.
PR smoke packs: pack_01_clean, pack_02_missing_rea, pack_09_bad_citation.
Nightly smoke repeats include pack_09 operator path, blocked export, and parity assertions.
Inject controlled failure to validate checkpoint halt and resume behavior.
Run concurrency tests validating idempotent run-start behavior.

preRun: Verify API and toolbar allowlist includes pack_09_bad_citation.
Verify readiness parity checks return no mismatches on packs 01 and 02.
Verify report invariant checks expect zero seeded fallback rows on successful runs.
postRun: Confirm no invalid run-state transitions occurred.
Confirm blocked export behavior for pack_09 and no unsafe links issued.
Confirm checkpoint records and canonical telemetry tags exist for each story stage.
rollbackReadiness: Confirm rollback toggles are available for allowlist, checkpoint resume, and run/report mapping.

resolvedDecisions: Root prd.md/prd.json consolidation while keeping slice PRDs as references.
Single sequential overnight loop rather than parallel multi-loop execution.
Readiness reason enum centralized before Loop B.
Run polling cadence standardized to 2s active and stop at terminal.
pack_09 smoke in PR and nightly tiers.
No dedicated telemetry dashboard or separate copy-spec in this phase.
